Version 1.1.4

- Enhanced documentation for skill routing, input rules, and use-case guidance to improve usability and accuracy.
- Added detailed parameter recommendations and examples for each feature: keyword search, post detail, creator posts, and comment analysis.
- Clarified limitations and best practices for different link types and common user intentions.
- Expanded FAQ-style guidance and anti-patterns to help avoid common input mistakes.
- No functional changes—this update focuses on clearer instructions and better user experience.
